description: Use this when the user wants live Johnson Bros. appointment availability. Include zip and any known town/state for a customer booking inquiry. Outside-area or unresolved locations receive no windows. Without a location, this returns general capacity only, not eligibility to book; coverage_status is not_checked. Never call for a customer already found outside coverage. Do not promise or create an appointment; use request_booking and confirm_booking.

days.description: How many calendar days to search from start_date (or today), 1 to 14; default 7.

start_date.description: First day to search as YYYY-MM-DD in the company time zone; omit for today. Past dates are rejected.

state.description: Two-letter state code, normally MA; send only together with zip or town.

time_preference.description: Part of day to keep: any (default), morning, afternoon or evening.

town.description: Service town when known, e.g. "Quincy", sent alongside zip. A town without a ZIP returns needs_more_information; use check_service_area for town-only coverage questions.

zip.description: Service ZIP when known. Always include the customer location for a booking inquiry; outside-area requests receive no windows.

name: get_availability

end_time.description: Reserved three-hour job-block end; pass unchanged to request_booking.

start_time.description: Selected job-block start; pass unchanged to request_booking.

title: Get Open Booking Windows
